1.desc: Donut Trip is a hybrid from Good Green, here as a full 28g ounce of flower. It comes from Humboldt Seed Company's triploid genetics, a cross of (FC4N x VCP-S2) and Donutz Triploid, known for a sweet vanilla-cinnamon aroma. 2.desc: Grandaddy Purp Berry from The Growfather is a 1.2-gram indica-leaning hybrid infused pre-roll. Granddaddy Purp is an indica strain that crosses Mendocino Purps, Skunk, and Afghani. On the lab report the leading terpenes are limonene (a bright, zesty citrus note), beta-caryophyllene (a peppery, warm-spice edge) and myrcene (an earthy, ripe-fruit depth). Together they shape the aroma you notice when you first open it and the flavor on the exhale. Beyond THC, testing also shows measurable CBG, CBGA and CBN, minor cannabinoids that round out the overall profile. Indica-leaning strains are generally described as calm, mellow and body-forward. It suits the slower end of the day: a movie night, a long dinner, or an end-of-week wind-down on the couch. Infused pre-rolls are noticeably stronger than standard joints, so take small pulls and let it rest between hits. They also burn slower; light the tip evenly and rotate as you go. As with any new product, start low and go slow and give each session time before deciding on more. For adults 21 and over. Please consume responsibly and never drive after using cannabis.
